provenance.move_speed_mps: Fallback estimate 5.0 m/s. Verified own-seat training exports now supply a per-match observed motion envelope when available.
provenance.reaction_seconds: CHOSEN 0.5 s spotting/reaction duration; the kit fitter does not identify reaction time. Not a platform constant.

calibration.method: documented estimates; grid is 1 m cells, sites ~130 m from spawn, 115 s live rounds
calibration.note: FPS sim is a 2D route/visibility approximation (no shooting, height, or match engine). Objectives are local, not platform scores.
